definitions: The act of speaking in a quiet voice, especially without vibration of the vocal cords; the sound thus produced.

To speak softly or under one's breath, so as to be heard only by one near at hand; to utter words without sonant breath; to talk without that vibration of the vocal cords which gives sonorous, or vocal, sound.

To say (something) softly or under one's breath, so as to be heard only by one near at hand; to utter (something) without sonant breath, without that vibration of the vocal cords which gives sonorous, or vocal, sound.
Smooth and flexible; not rough, rugged, or harsh.
Be quiet; hold; stop; not so fast.

blocks.text: Whispering is an unvoiced mode of phonation in which the vocal cords are abducted so that they do not vibrate; air passes between the arytenoid cartilages to create audible turbulence during speech. Supralaryngeal articulation remains the same as in normal speech.

images.alt: A girl whispers to another girl.
